topic: Day 98 — reel — Loneliness is the absence of being known, not the absence of people
text:
Loneliness
is not being
[known], not
being alone.
caption:
You can be around people constantly and still feel it. Amount of contact and depth of connection are completely separate numbers.

Follow for one of these a day.
